Wayne Rooney reveals physical transformation and health changes

Wayne Rooney has spoken about his recent physical transformation, which he attributes to a nose job and abstaining from alcohol. He also stated that he is not taking "jabs," a term often used to refer to vaccines. The changes have been described as a 'glow up'.
